ambiguity_rate.definition: Evaluable physical instances whose primary outcome is unresolved ambiguity divided by all evaluable expected physical instances

unmatched_rate.definition: Evaluable expected physical instances with no accepted match divided by all evaluable expected physical instances

annotation_coverage.definition: Accepted candidate pairs with both endpoints resolvable in benchmark divided by all accepted candidate pairs

instance_precision.definition: Correctly recovered physical instances divided by unique ground-truth physical instances claimed in annotated predictions
